Elwynn Forest, the Forest of Elwynn or simply Elwynn, is a vast woodland of stately hardwoods nestled in the continent of Azeroth, just below the foothills of the Burning Steppes to the north. The Redridge Mountains lie to the east, and Duskwood lies to the south across the Nazferiti river. It is the heartland of the human Kingdom of kingdom of Stormwind and consequently is the starting point of all human adventurers.
Marshal Dughan serves as the municipal law enforcer for Goldshire and Marshal McBride serves as the municipal law enforcer for Northshire Valley. Though much of the forest was burned down during the First War, trees and lush glades have grown anew. Stormwind City lies northwest of the forest and is heavily patrolled by the Stormwind guards.

The [[Redridge Mountains]] lie to the east, and [[Duskwood]] lies to the south across the [[Nazferiti river]]. It is the heartland of the [[human]] Kingdom of [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]] and consequently is the starting point of all [[human]] [[adventurer]]s. [[Marshal Dughan]] serves as the municipal law enforcer for [[Goldshire]] and [[Marshal McBride]] serves as the municipal law enforcer for [[Northshire Valley]]. Though much of the forest was burned down during the [[First War]], trees and lush glades have grown anew.[[The World of Warcraft Townhall/World Map#Elwynn Forest]] [[Stormwind City]] lies northwest of the forest and is heavily patrolled by the Stormwind guards. ==History== ===Founding of Stormwind=== [[File:Stormwindcitypicture.jpg|thumb|[[Stormwind City]], capital of the realm.]] Circa 1,200 [[BDP]],[https://twitter.com/Loreology/status/506857492404391936 Loreology on Twitter] (2014-09-02) (dead link) Stormwind was founded by [[Faldir]] and the descendants of the [[Arathi tribe|Arathi]] bloodline, who had migrated south from the [[Arathor|Empire of Arathor]] in [[Lordaeron]]. Traveling past the rocky mountains of [[Khaz Modan]], their journey finally ended after many long seasons, and they settled in the northern region of the continent they would name [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]]. In a fertile valley, they founded the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]], which quickly became a self-sufficient power in its own right.[[The Seven Kingdoms]] Over the years, it found prosperity through the farmsteads that dotted the surrounding fertile region, and as its population grew, small towns sprang up in the nearby regions, notably in Elwynn Forest,{{Ref WoWCV1|159}} and ever since the humans settled their capital of [[Stormwind City]] in the forest, it has thrived under their stewardship. During the [[Gnoll War]] in 75 BDP, the village of [[Goldshire]] was attacked by the [[Redridge pack|Redridge]] [[gnoll]]s, who were repelled by the [[Stormwind Army]].[[On Your Mark... Get Set...]] ===Great Wars and aftermath=== During the [[First War]] in 3 [[ADP]], after [[Brightwood]], [[Westfall]], and the [[Redridge Mountains]] fell, thousands of [[orc]]s marched through Elwynn Forest and encircled [[Stormwind City]], cutting off all access except for the sea. When [[Kilrogg Deadeye]] and [[Cho'gall]] led their [[Bleeding Hollow clan|Bleeding Hollow]] and [[Twilight's Hammer]] clans in the assault of the human capital, [[Anduin Lothar|Knight Champion Anduin Lothar]] led the [[Knights of Stormwind]] in a charge through Elwynn Forest, catching the orcs in the rearguard completely by surprise. Outflanked on both sides and suffering many casualties, the orcs were left with no choice but to flee.{{Ref WoWCV2|132}} In Year 4 ADP, [[Goldshire]] and [[Moonbrook]] were the final two towns to fall to the [[Old Horde|Orcish Horde]], as [[Warchief]] [[Blackhand]] sought to sever the lifeline between [[Llane Wrynn I|King Llane Wrynn I]] and his people in preparation of the sack of [[Stormwind Keep]].[[Goldshire and Moonbrook (WC1 Orc)]] The second siege of Stormwind ultimately ended with the capital reduced to ruins, and Lothar taking on the mantle of regent lord to guide the [[refugee]]s to [[Lordaeron]] aboard thousands of boats.''[[Tides of Darkness]]'', Prologue The ruins of Stormwind City were then lorded over by the [[orc]]s of the [[Stormreaver clan]].''[[Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness]]'' manual, ''[[Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness manual#Stormreaver Clan|Clans of the Horde]]'', Stormreaver Clan After the [[Second War]] ended in 6 ADP, special importance was placed on rebuilding Stormwind, with [[Turalyon|Supreme Commander Turalyon]] overseeing the repatriation of the citizens in Elwynn Forest.{{Ref WoWCV2|177}} [[Archbishop]] [[Alonsus Faol]] of the [[Church of the Light]] notably aided in rebuilding [[Northshire Abbey]].[[Alonsus Faol#Death and remembrance]] To this day, the only reminders of the Horde's occupation are a few scattered orcish [[catapult]]s, broken and rotting across the region. After the [[Stonemasons Guild]] spent years toiling to rebuild Stormwind City, they were left broke, as their fees and salaries were left unpaid and unspoken for by the city's officials. When the time of the rightful payment came, the [[House of Nobles]] couldn't because they ran up a huge debt by expanding the kingdom's military presence through Elwynn and into [[Stranglethorn Vale|Stranglethorn]], and the massive debt crippled the kingdom's economy.[[Shaw's Report]] When [[Edwin VanCleef|Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef]] demanded restitution for their works, the nobles ordered the guild disbanded, which resulted in riots that led to the murder of [[Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn|Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn]] and the creation of the [[Defias Brotherhood]].[[Report on the Defias Brotherhood]] ===World of Warcraft=== {{Wow-section}} [[File:Northshireabbey.jpg|thumb|[[Northshire Abbey]] rebuilt in its [[Northshire Valley|eponymous valley]].]] By the Year 25 ADP, many [[wolf|wolves]] fled from [[Duskwood]] to Elwynn,[[Marshal McBride's Documents]] (original) scared by the darkness taking over the forest. Long ago, Elwynn was populated with a group of [[spider]]s that lived peacefully amid the woods, until the curse that fell over Brightwood turned the once peaceful woodland into a realm of terror. The spiders began to [[Venom spider|mutate and grow]] to monstrous proportions, and entered the shadowed land.[[The World of Warcraft Townhall/Beastiary#Venom Spider]] After [[Azeroth]] had been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels, the [[mage]]s of the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] struggled to determine the effects these changes had caused, and some of them feared the worst. When the flow of magic in [[Stormwind City]] and Elwynn Forest was somehow altered, they sent a mage [[adventurer]] to [[Mirror Lake]], in order to test its water for magical properties before those who drank from it would be adversely affected.[[Mirror Lake (quest)]] At some point, a [[Elwynn murlocs|group of murlocs]] inhabiting [[Stone Cairn Lake]] became a local nuisance, responsible for the deaths of many people.[[Find the Lost Guards]] [[Guard Thomas]] feared that if things didn't soon improved, there would be fighting in Goldshire after a few days,[[Deliver Thomas' Report]] and [[Marshal Dughan]] eventually placed a bounty on the murlocs for the adventurers.[[Bounty on Murlocs]][[A Fishy Peril quest chain]] ===Wrath of the Lich King=== {{Wotlk-section}} Shortly before the [[Scourge Invasion (Stormwind)|Scourge Invasion]] in 27 ADP, the [[Scourge]] launched an attack on [[Goldshire]].''[[World of Warcraft: The Comic]]'', Issue 17: ''[[Gathering Thunder!]]'' ===Cataclysm=== {{cata-section}} During the [[Cataclysm (event)|Shattering]] in 28 ADP, the earthquakes opened a break in the mountain between Elwynn Forest and the [[Burning Steppes]],[[Beating Them Back!]][[Extinguishing Hope]] allowing a force of [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] [[orc]]s led by [[Kurtok the Slayer]] to invade [[Northshire Valley]].[[Ending the Invasion!]] When the [[Stormwind Army]] was deployed, the orcs took over and burned down the [[Northshire Vineyards]], planning their final assault against the human defenders,[[Blackrock Invasion]] until [[Alliance]] [[adventurer]]s arrived in support to repel the [[Dark Horde]] invaders. After Kurtok was slain, [[peasant]]s were sent to seal the passage, so that no more orcs could come through. The Stormwind Army also had put a bounty on [[Hogger]] and incarcerates him to the [[Stockades]] in the aftermath of his defeat.[[WANTED: "Hogger"]] ===Elegy=== {{novel-section}} During the [[War of the Thorns]] in 33 ADP, the flood of [[Night elf|night elves]] [[refugee]]s from [[Darnassus]] spread to seemingly every surface of Stormwind, and spilled out most of the way to [[Goldshire]].''[[Elegy]]'', pg. 78 ===Shadowlands=== {{sl-section}} During [[Death Rising]] in 35 ADP, Elwynn Forest came under attack from the [[Scourge]], until the [[Stormwind Army]] and the [[Argent Crusade]] were mobilized to repel the [[undead]].[[Cause for Distraction]] ==People and culture== [[File:Goldshire.jpg|thumb|[[Goldshire]], the main town of the region.]] The [[human]]s have lived in Elwynn for centuries, but members of all [[Alliance]] races can be frequently seen traveling and residing in Elwynn due to its proximity to the capital, [[Stormwind City]]. Most residents of Elwynn are involved in one of its major industries: logging, farming, fishing, or mining. They are also renowned for the breeding of their [[Evendale]]s: steeds especially prized by adventurers for their loyalty and steadiness in the face of danger. The people are hardy and hard-working and for all its pomp and grandeur, Stormwind wouldn’t last long without a constant stream of food and supplies to support the city’s population.[https://web.archive.org/web/20150326082809/http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/race/human Races of World of Warcraft: Human] The region hosts the [[Wickerman Festival|burning of the Wickerman]] and is also visited periodically by the famous [[Darkmoon Faire]]. ==Geography== [[File:Eastvale.jpg|thumb|left|upright=0.9|[[Eastvale Logging Camp]]]] Elwynn lies below the southern foothills of [[Blackrock Mountain]]. The Forest is a labyrinthine mixture of rushing rivers, various lakes, and forests of magnificent trees and lush glades. Its rich farmland is a result of frequent rains. Recently, several of the lakes have been found to be inhabited by hostile [[murloc]]s. Stormwind City itself sits proudly in the northwestern hills of the region, its gates opening down onto the Forest. East of Stormwind and behind a thick wall lies the peaceful [[Northshire Valley]] and its Abbey. Northshire was the pride of Stormwind's vineyards until Defias bandits drove off the farmers and occupied the farm and fields. Though the Defias were eventually taken down, Northshire couldn't catch a break: after the Cataclysm it was invaded by [[goblin]] assassins and [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] orcs, who ate the grapes and burned the vineyards. The formerly [[kobold]]-infested [[Echo Ridge Mine]] has been closed up. [[Bear]]s, [[Wolf|wolves]], [[spider]]s, and [[boar]]s constitute the bulk of the region's large wildlife. The creatures are hostile everywhere except for Northshire. The roads leading from Stormwind and Northshire converge to the southeast just north of [[Goldshire]]. Goldshire is Elwynn's largest settlement besides Stormwind itself. Second to Goldshire is the [[Eastvale Logging Camp]] in the east near the border with [[Redridge Mountains]]. Eastvale is the center of Elwynn's lumber industry. On the road from Goldshire to Eastvale is the [[Tower of Azora]] where mages conduct arcane experiments in seclusion. On the road to Westfall from Goldshire is the imposing [[Westbrook Garrison]]. This barracks and surrounding grounds house a number of the Stormwind Guard and protects Elwynn's western border. Dotted throughout the forest are small farmsteads growing crops such as wheat, pumpkins, melons, and grapes. Kobolds infested the [[Jasperlode Mine]] and [[Fargodeep Mine]]. [[Gnolls]] have erected camps in the [[Forest's Edge]] region and the northern rim of [[Stone Cairn Lake]]. It is rumored that both the kobolds and gnolls are somehow associated with the [[Defias Brotherhood]]. [[Murloc]]s have taken up residence in and around [[Stone Cairn Lake]] and [[Crystal Lake]]. Defias presence in the region has been growing and their people have holdings at [[Mirror Lake Orchard]], [[Northshire Vineyards]], the [[Brackwell Pumpkin Patch]], [[Jerod's Landing]], and [[Stone Cairn Lake]], until they were taken down. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Elwynn Forest.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Elwynn Forest.]] [[File:VZ-Elwynn Forest-old1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Elwynn Forest prior to ''[[World of Warcraft: Cataclysm|Cataclysm]]''.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Brackwell Pumpkin Patch]] *[[Crystal Lake]] *[[Eastvale Logging Camp]] *[[Fargodeep Mine]] *[[Forest's Edge]] **[[Hogger Hill]] **[[Westbrook Garrison]] *[[Goldshire]] **[[Lion's Pride Inn]] *[[Goldtooth's Den]] *[[Jasperlode Mine]] *[[Jerod's Landing]] *[[Maclure Vineyards|The Maclure Vineyards]] *[[Mirror Lake]] **[[Mirror Lake Orchard]] *[[Ridgepoint Tower]] *[[Stone Cairn Lake]] **[[Heroes' Vigil]] *[[Stonefield Farm|The Stonefield Farm]] *[[Stormwind Gate]] **{{Alliance}} [[Stormwind City]] *[[Thunder Falls]] *[[Tower of Azora]] |- || ---- ;[[Northshire Valley]] *[[Echo Ridge Mine]] *[[Northshire Abbey]] **[[Hall of Arms (Northshire)|Hall of Arms]] **[[Library Wing (Northshire)|Library Wing]] **[[Main Hall (Northshire)|Main Hall]] *[[Northshire Vineyards]] |- || ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *[[Agee Tyler's farm]] *[[Darkmoon Faire Staging Area]] *[[Nazferiti river]] *[[Northshire River]] |- || ---- ;Removed locations *[[Darkhollow Mine]] *[[Stormwind Mountains]] *[[Thieves Camp]] |- || ---- ;{{WC1-inline}} [[Warcraft: Orcs & Humans]] *[[Sunnyglade]] (presumed) |- || ---- ;{{RPG-inline}} [[Warcraft RPG]] *[[Westbrook Garrison#In the RPG|Westridge]] |} [http://wow.gamepressure.com/map.asp?ID=7 Topographic map of Elwynn Forest]

As the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]] rips across the world, the trading routes of Elwynn Forest are threatened by [[kobold]]s taking over the gold mines, feuds between families, attacks from wild animals, farms being overrun by bandits, and the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock orcs]] invading through the north. The whole zone deals with an investigation, for these seemingly unrelated threats could all have the same cause behind it, and with the army stretched thin, and Stormwind's economy on the brink of collapse, it falls to its citizens to defend their kingdom and restore the peace. ==Resources== *[[Cloth]]: **[[Linen Cloth]] *Herbalism **[[Peacebloom]] **[[Silverleaf]] **[[Earthroot]] *Skinning **[[Ruined Leather Scraps]] **[[Light Leather]] *Mining **[[Copper Ore]] (mostly in the mines) *[[Fish]] - Fishing skill 25 needed to fish open water without catching junk **[[Raw Brilliant Smallfish]] **[[Raw Longjaw Mud Snapper]] **[[Bloated Smallfish]] **[[15 Pound Mud Snapper]] ==Battle pets== {{mop-section}} {{columns|2| *[[Small Frog]] *[[Silver Tabby Cat]] - ''[[Vendor]]'' *[[Cornish Rex Cat]] - ''Vendor'' *[[Bombay Cat]] - ''Vendor'' *[[Sinister Squashling]] - ''[[Hallow's End]]'' only *[[Spring Rabbit]] - ''[[Noblegarden]]'' only *[[Feline Familiar]] - ''Hallow's End'' only *[[Black Lamb]] *[[Orange Tabby Cat]] - ''Vendor'' *[[Rabbit]] *[[Squirrel]] *[[Fawn]] *[[Cat]] *[[Chicken]] *[[Stormwind Rat]] *[[Fangs (snake)|Fangs]] {{Untameable}} *[[Slither (battle pet)|Slither]] {{Untameable}} }} ==Wild creatures== [[File:Elwynn Boar HS.jpg|thumb|upright|{{HS|Elwynn Boar}} in ''[[Hearthstone (game)|Hearthstone]]''.]] *{{RaceIcon|Bear}} [[Bear]]s *{{RaceIcon|Boar}} [[Boar]]s *{{RaceIcon|Gnoll}} [[Gnoll]]s *{{RaceIcon|Kobold}} [[Kobold]]s *{{RaceIcon|Murloc|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Murloc|Female}} [[Murloc]]s *{{RaceIcon|Spider}} [[Spider]]s *{{RaceIcon|Wolf}} [[Wolf|Wolves]] ==In the RPG== {{RPG-section}} Elwynn is a gorgeous span of fertile land and thick forests. The weather is brightly sunny and cheerful during the day and silent and peaceful at night. Unlike [[Duskwood]], it is close enough to Stormwind to enjoy considerable Alliance guardianship. Home to many farmers, loggers, and miners, Elwynn Forest is a tranquil region with several friendly places to stop. Little troubles this region; kobolds infiltrate some mines, and murlocs have moved inland to reside in some lakes and rivers, but overall it is safe. One should stick to the roads though, as the forest is home to many fearsome and territorial creatures. Those who can defend themselves are not in any danger, but others may not be so lucky. Elwynn enjoys consistently good weather, warm and humid with few stormy days. Gentle rain falls just enough to make everything grow full and lush.''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 48 This woodland is pleasant and tranquil. Loggers and fishers fuel Stormwind’s economy, and a diligent militia keeps it safe from the kobolds and murlocs that occasionally surface. The Defias Brotherhood, a group of robbers and bandits wearing red masks, has recently become a growing menace in the region.''[[World of Warcraft The Roleplaying Game]]'', pg. 16 The Brotherhood reaches into Elwynn Forest from time to time, preying on lone travelers, although their main center of operations lies somewhere in [[Westfall]]. Some say they have a case against Stormwind, as they weren’t paid for their work rebuilding the city; others say they are whiners who charged too much in the first place. Others (such as [[Brann Bronzebeard]]) did their work and were paid, and don’t understand the problems.''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 49 Elwynn Forest is under guardianship of the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]] but has its own democratic government. True criminals in the area are usually sent to Stormwind for trial and punishment in the [[Stormwind Stockade|Stockade]], as most people care more for their jobs than housing criminals. Goldshire has a small holding area for drunks and pickpockets, but few stay in the clink for very long. Elwynn’s towns will welcome most any travelers, especially those who want to shop or trade to help the local economies. They are especially kind to those willing to lend a hand in a tough spot. ==Film universe== {{movie-section}} Elwynn Forest is depicted close to its ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' incarnation. It contains the communities of [[Goldshire#Film universe|Goldshire]] and [[Northshire Abbey#Film universe|Northshire Abbey]]. A [[murloc]] can be seen and the laughter of a [[gnoll]] can be heard in the forest. ==Notes and trivia== *[[Bimble Longberry]] fruits come from the forests of Elwynn. *The [[farm]]s of the [[Mr. Blackridge|Blackridge]], [[Mr. Woodring|Woodring]], and [[Liam]]'s families are located near [[Goldshire]]. The [[Defias Brotherhood]] kidnapped the Blackridges and moved them to the [[Deadmines]] at some point.''[[Legends Volume 4]]'', ''[[Bloodsail Buccaneer]]'' *There was an [[Alliance]] ship named the ''[[Elwynn (ship)|Elwynn]]''. *The two rival farmsteads, [[Stonefield Farm]] and [[Maclure Vineyards]], may be a reference to the real-world [[wikipedia:Hatfield-McCoy feud|Hatfield/McCoy feud]]. *Elwynn Forest is prominently featured in ''South Park'''s "[[Make Love, Not Warcraft (episode)|Make Love, Not Warcraft]]''" episode. *This starting zone is usually the highest populated due to Stormwind and the Goldshire dueling phenomenon. *Since {{g|cata}}, a [[Agee Tyler's farm|small sheep farm]] in the mountains around [[Northshire Valley]] is inhabited by a gnome named [[Agee Tyler]], a reference to the Blizzard employee Tyler Agee. *On most servers, [[Goldshire]] is an Alliance player hangout with people everywhere dueling and talking. ==Gallery== ;''World of Warcraft'' File:Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.jpg|[[Brackwell Pumpkin Patch]] File:Crystal Lake.jpg|[[Crystal Lake]] File:Fargodeep Mine.jpg|[[Fargodeep Mine]] File:Heroes' Vigil.jpg|[[Heroes' Vigil]] File:Jasperlode Mine.jpg|[[Jasperlode Mine]] File:Jerod's Landing.jpg|[[Jerod's Landing]] File:The Maclure Vineyards.jpg|[[Maclure Vineyards]] File:Mirror Lake Orchard.jpg|[[Mirror Lake Orchard]] File:Northshire Vineyards Cata.jpg|[[Northshire Vineyards]] File:Northshire River.jpg|[[Northshire River]] File:Ridgepoint Tower.jpg|[[Ridgepoint Tower]] File:The Stonefield Farm.jpg|[[Stonefield Farm]] File:Darkmoon Staging Ground - Elwynn.jpg|[[Darkmoon Faire Staging Area]] in Elwynn Forest. ;Maps and art File:Elwynn Forest in Dark Riders.jpg|Elwynn in ''[[Dark Riders]]''.
